messages:
sam_release: Heads-up: scheduling a deploy TOMORROW 10:00 PT. It's a roll-forward for model v3.2 (perf + safety filter tweaks) + routing change to prefer cheaper GPU pool. No DB/schema changes. Canary first, then promote if green. ETA for full rollout ~30–40m.

maria_pm: Thanks Sam. Who's owning the deploy + smoke? Also can we get a one-paragraph support blurb for CS?

dan_engineer: I can own the deploy and canary monitoring. I'll run the rollout and watch metrics.

jess_sre: I'll run the smoke checklist and monitor lat/error rates, tracing, and kv-cache hitrate. Plan: 5% canary for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if stable. If errors spike >1.5x baseline or latency p95 > 2x baseline, we rollback.

leo_cs: I'll draft a short CS note: what changed, expected user impact (none visible), and rollback plan. Will post in #support 1 hour before deploy.

nina_marketing: Pause any scheduled outbound campaigns starting 09:30 PT until 11:30 PT to avoid customers hitting mid-rollout. We'll reschedule if rollout still in progress.

sam_release: Great. Minimal config revert is ready if needed: rollback = pin routing to v3.1 + restore previous TTL. Dan, can you confirm the exact commands?

dan_engineer: Yep — rollback steps (manual quick):
```
# pin traffic to previous model version
redwood api set-route --route default --model redwood/v3.1 --weight 100
# restore cache TTL
redwood config set --key kv.cache.ttl --value 3600
```
I'll have that ready as a script.

jess_sre: Smoke checklist (short):
1) Health endpoints green on canary hosts
2) Send sample prompts to canary (chat + long context)
3) Verify token cost and latency not regressing
4) Check function/tool calling flows in canary
5) Validate logs/traces are ingested and no error spikes

Example quick test:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize this product changelog...","max_tokens":60}' | jq .
```

sam_release: Perfect. CS/marketing, please add your notes to the shared docs: https://redwood.internal/launches/v3.2 so support has copy and marketing has the go/no-go.

leo_cs: Draft done, added to doc and pinned. Key line for support: "If model regressions are observed, we'll revert traffic to v3.1; see rollback runbook in the doc."

maria_pm: Any expected user-visible behavior changes?

dan_engineer: None expected. Slightly improved latency on some long-context requests and better filtering on flagged tokens. We'll keep an eye on hallucination-related evals but no config changes that should change outputs drastically.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Scheduled deploy created by @sam_release for 2026-04-01 10:00 PT. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Reminder 60m before.

jess_sre: I'll post the smoke results in this thread as they run. Dan, I'll ping you immediately if we cross thresholds. :thumbsup:

dan_engineer: Thanks — I'll be online at 09:45 PT and ready to execute.

nina_marketing: I'll confirm campaign pause and update ops channel when done.

sam_release: Thanks everyone — sticking to the timeline. If anyone can't make the window, speak up now. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan. :rocket:
